verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is itself an official, model-agnostic Python SDK with typed agents, built-in support for many providers, an official CLI (clai), and rich documentation on tools, output types, message history, and multi-agent patterns — exactly what an AI-native builder needs to build against an official SDK. Community reports (comm-1, comm-2, comm-5, comm-7, comm-12, comm-13) confirm real production usage and strong support, though some (comm-4, comm-6, comm-8, comm-10) note rough edges in structured-output reliability and streaming support for certain providers. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of full provider parity, and resolution of the documented streaming/structured-output edge-case failures.
